systems.owner: National Civil Registration Authority (NCRA) and Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation (MoCTI), under an MoU signed 10 May 2024
systems.tiers: National; to be established, for real-time identity verification and data exchange between NCRA and ministries, departments and agencies
National; primary host for identity data, offering hosting to ministries, departments and agencies

note: An MoU on identity data hosting and exchange; birth and death registration appear only as items of the NCRA website menu, and nothing is said of how offices record events.
